title: Fail-closed admin server: non-loopback without bearer token is a startup error
description: Both start_admin_server implementations (transit/src/admin.rs:106, reader/src/admin.rs:30) return Err if addr is non-loopback and bearer_token is None. This is the correct default. A future contributor might suggest making this a warning or adding a 'force' flag. Resist: the admin endpoint exposes internal state and has a POST /reload that future versions will make destructive. Fail-closed is the right posture.
